Prove the sharp tariff for paid UT3 central calls

Exact positive uniform tariff for k UT3 central targets when rank-one calls of a,b,c are all paid, for every finite register count with restored arbitrary dirt.

Scope and remaining obligations are in the package README. No selected frontier change or new kappa. Prepared for woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. [Coordinated research batch](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18922638); round 01. The selected record is unchanged.
